content_sections.heading: NIT Rourkela Field Assistant at a Glance
content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts National Institute of Technology Rourkela (NIT Rourkela) has notified 2 vacancies for the Field Assistant post under the ANRF-PAIR project. The appointment is project-based, purely temporary, and co-terminus with the project for an initial period of 1 year, extendable based on satisfactory performance. Eligible candidates must hold a Bachelor’s Degree in any Science discipline (B.Sc.) or a 3-year Diploma in Engineering & Technology with a minimum of 55% marks, and be up to 50 years of age with relaxations as per norms. The notified pay is Rs. 27,000 per month + HRA. Applicants must send a single PDF file containing the filled and signed application form, mark sheets, certificates, research papers, and work experience certificates via email by 29 October 2026. Selection will be through shortlisting followed by an online interview.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Post Name: Field Assistant (FA) Number of Vacancies: 02 (Two)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s Degree in any Science discipline (B.Sc.) or a 3-year Diploma in Engineering & Technology from a recognized University/Institute/Board with a minimum of 55% marks. Candidates possessing a Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering/Technology (B.E./B.Tech.) or a degree in Civil, Mechanical, Mining, or allied disciplines may be given preference based on their suitability for the project requirements and performance in the selection process. Experience in field data collection, or other research related field activities. Basic proficiency in data entry and data handling using MS Office and MS Excel. Willingness to undertake field visits and travel to project/study locations as required. Good communication and interpersonal skills, with proficiency in English and Hindi. Ability to interact effectively with research teams and industry personnel. Experience in maintaining field records, organizing collected data, and supporting research/project documentation is desirable. Interest or prior exposure to research projects will be an advantage. The upper age limit for applying is up to 50 years. The age limit is relaxed up to 5 years in the case of candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, PwWD, and Female applicants, whereas 3 years in the case of OBCs (Non-creamy layer candidates). The upper age limit shall be reckoned as on the last date of receipt of applications. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 27,000/- per month plus HRA as applicable per ANRF norms. The appointment will be for 1 year initially and the tenure will be extended based on satisfactory performance. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the ANRF-PAIR project (up to 13-October-2030) and does not confer any right or claim for regular appointment at NIT Rourkela.

content_sections.heading: NIT Rourkela Field Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The Field Assistant will be responsible for the following duties and key responsibilities: Support Junior Research Fellows (JRFs) and the Co-Principal Investigators with day-to-day operational logistics, experiment setups, and report drafting. Assist the Co-Principal Investigators' research team in field visits, surveys, sample/data collection from mines and nearby industries, laboratory and experimental activities, maintenance of field records, and other related work as assigned. Conduct and coordinate field visits, surveys, data/sample collection, and other project-related field activities. Assist in planning field schedules and managing on-site logistics for surveys and data-collection campaigns. Perform data entry, compilation, verification, and preliminary processing/cleaning of collected data. Maintain systematic and accurate field records, survey forms, databases, photographs, and other supporting documentation. Assist the research team in laboratory/field experiments, sample handling, measurements, or related technical activities, wherever applicable. Coordinate with industry and project personnel during field activities. Provide logistical support for project meetings, workshops, training programmes, awareness activities, and other project events. Submit regular field updates and collected information to energy and environmental project teams. Undertake travel to project locations as and when required.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on merit and the need of the project. Only short-listed candidates will be informed for an Online Interview. The period of experience in a discipline or area of work, wherever prescribed, shall be counted after the date of acquiring the minimum prescribed educational qualifications for that position. Mere possession of minimum qualification does not guarantee invitation to the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Rourkela Field Assistant recruitment 2026?

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Field Assistant post?

faq.question: Q3. What is the monthly salary for the NIT Rourkela Field Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 27,000/- plus HRA as per ANRF norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s Degree in any Science discipline (B.Sc.) or a 3-year Diploma in Engineering & Technology from a recognized University, Institute, or Board with a minimum of 55% marks.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit to apply for this post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is up to 50 years, with relaxations up to 5 years for SC, ST, PwWD, and female applicants, and 3 years for OBC non-creamy layer candidates as per norms.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates must send a single PDF file containing the filled and signed application form along with mark sheets, certificates, and relevant documents to [email protected] by the last date.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for the Field Assistant position?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted based on merit and project requirements, followed by an online interview for shortlisted applicants.

faq.question: Q9. Is this job permanent at NIT Rourkela?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely temporary and contractual, and co-terminus with the ANRF-PAIR project, offering no claim for regular appointment at NIT Rourkela.
